findings.statement: SOTA autonomous code resolution on SWE-bench Verified is ~79% (all-agents, late-2025 plateau) up to ~97% on scaffolded single-model runs — EVERY top entry is driven by a FRONTIER LLM (Opus 5, DeepSeek V4, GPT-5.6). The curve jumped 13.86%→65% in 16 months, then plateaued <80% for all-agents.
findings.odgGap: ODG has NO native frontier-LLM code-reasoning. Its native capability is the DETERMINISTIC GOVERNANCE/VERIFICATION layer, not novel code synthesis. Honest: novel code generation remains CLAUDE_CODE_EXECUTION (a frontier LLM); ODG can natively do deterministic/template engineering + orchestration + verification.
findings.opportunity: build ODG's NATIVE deterministic engineering-cycle (template codegen for a bounded class + native test gen + native execution + mechanical repair) — a real, measurable advance that is honestly scoped.

findings.statement: The research consensus: the reliability frontier is a DETERMINISTIC orchestration/governance layer above the model + persistent memory/context + root-cause reconstruction. 'Every failure traces back to the agent not having the right context.'
findings.odgStrength: this is exactly ODG's architecture (9 primitives, Truth-Lock, memory, root-cause engineering, deterministic gate). ODG is well-aligned with the governance frontier; the gap is the generative step only.

findings.statement: Position ODG as the governed deterministic layer that ORCHESTRATES + VERIFIES a frontier generative provider, while growing its NATIVE deterministic-engineering surface (mechanical codegen/repair) where an LLM is not required.
